title: MemoryRecord
description: One memory. scope private: only the owner reads it. team: every agent in the owner's chart branch (the branch whose root agent is team) reads it. common: every agent reads it. Root agents read all memories. Search is full-text over title, body and tags; there are no embeddings.

owner.description: Agent that wrote the memory and may change it.

team.description: Root agent of the owner's chart branch when the memory was written. Decides who reads team memories.

revision.description: Starts at 1 and rises by 1 on every change. Writers send the revision they read; a mismatch is a conflict.

Link.description: A pointer to something the memory is about. ref is an id for memory, task, event and message; a URL for url; an absolute path for file.

MemorySource.description: Where the content came from. ref is the agent or human name, event id, import file or plugin name.
